jobs.title: Sales Executive (London-based)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join us in redefining the creator economy with AI

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We’re an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200M+ in annual recurring revenue with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

As Fanvue continues to scale internationally, this role exists to strengthen our commercial presence in London, one of the most important global hubs for creator agencies, talent managers, and media businesses. This is a frontline sales role focused on revenue, relationships, and long-term creator partnerships.

🎯 The Role

We’re hiring a B2B Sales Representative based in London to drive Fanvue’s growth across creators, agencies, and talent management companies. This is a hands-on sales role for someone entrepreneurial, commercially sharp, and motivated by building high-value relationships in a fast-moving market.

You’ll take ownership of outbound sales, pipeline development, and deal execution, helping position Fanvue as the platform of choice for creators and the partners who represent them globally.

🚀 What You’ll Do

  • Own outbound B2B sales across creators, agencies, and talent managers in the UK and Europe

  • Build and manage a strong pipeline through outreach, networking, and in-person meetings

  • Convert prospects into long-term, revenue-generating creator partnerships

  • Manage all activity, deal progress, and relationships accurately in the CRM

  • Re-engage existing leads to uncover new commercial opportunities

  • Represent Fanvue at industry events, meetings, and community activations in London

  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Growth teams to align campaigns and messaging

  • Share market insights, objections, and competitive intelligence with leadership and product

  • Track performance against targets and report clearly on pipeline, conversion, and revenue

👀 Who You Are

  • Proven experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or commercial roles in tech, media, or the creator economy

  • Comfortable selling directly to creators, agencies, and senior stakeholders

  • Strong relationship builder with a consultative, commercial mindset

  • Highly self-motivated and comfortable working independently

  • Resilient, persuasive, and confident handling objections

  • Clear, credible communicator with strong negotiation skills

  • Data-driven and target-oriented, with ownership of results

✨ You’ll Thrive Here If

  • You enjoy building pipelines and closing deals from scratch

  • You value autonomy and accountability

  • You like being in the room with decision-makers and creators

  • You are motivated by clear revenue targets

⚠️ You’ll Struggle Here If

  • You need heavy structure or constant oversight

  • You prefer inbound leads over proactive sales

  • You are uncomfortable operating in fast-moving environments

  • You avoid clear sales accountability

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Be a key commercial hire in Fanvue’s London presence

  • Competitive base salary and uncapped commission structure

  • High autonomy and visibility with direct access to leadership

  • Opportunity to shape Fanvue’s global creator and agency relationships

  • Unlimited holiday

  • Hybrid working with access to our London office

  • Budget for growth and wellbeing

  • A culture that values innovation, ownership, transparency, and speed

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We believe diverse teams build better companies. Even if you do not meet every single requirement listed, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and growth matter just as much as experience.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.descriptionHtml:
💰 £50,000 to £90,000 depending on experience

📍 Salary based on London. Hybrid, with flexible hours.

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

We have gone from 45 people to over 130 in a year while doubling revenue. Finance has kept pace, but the processes underneath were built for a much smaller company, and our first statutory audit is coming. This role exists to build the controls and reporting discipline a business at this scale should already have.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Financial Controller to own Fanvue's financial operations and reporting, reporting directly to our VP Finance.

This is hands-on. You will own statutory reporting, compliance and management accounting, while strengthening controls, improving reporting accuracy and taking cost out. It suits a qualified accountant with strong technical knowledge under IFRS, commercial instincts, and experience building finance processes that scale rather than inheriting ones that already work.

You will have real influence on how the finance function is built, because much of it is still being built.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Lead the month-end and quarter-end close, delivering timely and accurate reporting

  • Prepare management accounts, cash flow forecasts and variance analysis

  • Own statutory reporting and compliance under IFRS and UK GAAP

  • Manage VAT filings, PAYE submissions and annual HMRC returns

  • Maintain and optimise Xero and the wider finance stack, including Dext, Pleo and ApprovalMax

  • Support annual audits and manage the relationship with external accountants

  • Strengthen internal controls, financial policies and reporting processes

  • Partner with leadership on budgeting, forecasting and margin improvement

  • Take on projects including R&D tax credit claims and system integrations

👀 Who You Are

  • Qualified accountant, ACA, ACCA, CPA or CIMA

  • 4 to 6 years post-qualification, ideally from Big Four, a regional practice, or high-growth tech or digital

  • Strong knowledge of IFRS and UK statutory reporting

  • Proficient in Xero and comfortable with finance automation tools

  • Experienced with VAT and HMRC compliance

  • Comfortable with consolidations and multi-currency accounting

  • Strong analytically, precise on detail, and proactive rather than reactive

  • At ease in a fast-moving, hands-on environment

Nice to have

  • Experience in the creator economy, a marketplace, a subscription platform or fintech

  • Exposure to R&D tax credits, multi-entity or multi-currency accounting

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You want to build the finance function rather than run one someone else designed

  • You would rather fix the process than work around it for another quarter

  • You like being close to commercial decisions instead of reporting on them afterwards

  • You are comfortable being the person who says the number is wrong, and then finding out why

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You want established processes, a settled close calendar and a team already in place

  • You would rather specialise deeply than cover a broad surface

  • You need someone senior to define the controls before you can implement them

  • You are uncomfortable with a business that changes shape faster than the reporting can keep up

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • A genuine chance to shape the finance function of a company growing this fast

  • Report directly to the VP Finance with real exposure to strategic decision-making

  • Fanvue supports hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans globally. The problems you solve here are real and immediate

  • Series A momentum: triple-digit growth means the work you do now sets the standard for years

  • Unlimited holiday

  • Hybrid working, with flexible hours according to when you work best

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

  • Budget for growth and wellbeing, plus support with upskilling and development costs

  • A culture built on innovation, speed, excellence, ownership and transparency

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200M+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

As Fanvue scales, we are building AI-native products that differentiate us in the creator economy. This role exists for high-agency product engineers who care about what they build as much as how they build it, ship quickly, and use AI as a core part of how they work.

£130,000

📍 Salary based on London. Other locations may vary.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer who thinks like a product owner and ships like a startup engineer.

You'll own features from idea to launch, working directly with Product and Design to decide what to build, then building it across our TypeScript, React and Node.js stack. You'll put work in front of creators and fans fast, read how it lands, and iterate. You'll have real ownership of product areas from day one, with the autonomy to shape them.

AI is central to how we build and to what our product does. You'll use AI-assisted development tools daily and build AI-powered features that change how creators run their business.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Own product features end to end, from scoping and design input through to launch, iteration and measuring impact

  • Build full-stack across TypeScript, React, Next.js and Node.js, including the APIs and data models behind your features

  • Work with Product and Design to shape the roadmap, challenge assumptions and find the simplest path to value

  • Build AI-powered product experiences, including chat, content generation, personalisation and moderation

  • Experiment with LLMs, embeddings and AI integrations inside real user workflows

  • Use data and user feedback to decide what to build next and what to cut

  • Leverage AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot to accelerate delivery

  • Stay close to the people using what you build: talk to creators, read support feedback, watch the metrics

  • Contribute to technical discussions, engineering standards and code reviews, and help less experienced engineers level up

👀 Who You Are

  • 5+ years of professional experience building and regularly shipping user-facing product

  • Strong product sense, with clear examples of features you owned and the results they drove

  • Production experience with TypeScript and React, plus solid API and backend work in Node.js (REST, GraphQL, Next.js API routes or similar)

  • Experience at fast-moving startups or scale-ups where you shipped often and owned outcomes

  • High agency: you identify problems and solve them without waiting for direction

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, turning a loose problem into a shipped solution without a perfect spec

  • Fluent with AI coding assistants and curious about building with LLMs

  • Relentless in execution: you ship, iterate and improve

  • Open to feedback and generous with it

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You care about the outcome for users, not just the quality of the code

  • You want to see your work in front of creators and fans within days, not quarters

  • You prefer ownership and responsibility over narrow task execution

  • You've built things on your own initiative, at work or outside it

  • You believe AI-native development is the future

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You need highly detailed specifications before starting

  • You'd rather stay in one layer of the stack than own the whole feature

  • You're uncomfortable with rapid iteration and feedback

  • You resist using AI tools as part of your workflow

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Fanvue supports hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans globally. The product you build here is in their hands immediately

  • AI-native engineering: we are not bolting AI on. It is core to our product and how we build

  • A company that values deep technical and product excellence, not just management progression

  • Series A momentum: triple-digit growth means the product you ship today defines the platform for years

  • Work alongside engineers who have shipped at scale across leading tech companies

  • Significant equity so you share in what we're building together

  • Fully remote with unlimited PTO, flexible working hours, a London office and WeWork access when you want it

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

  • Travel and office budgets for team off-sites or kitting out your home setup

  • Benefits package including gym memberships, apps, and more we're actively building out

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We believe diverse teams build better companies. Even if you do not meet every requirement listed, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and growth matter just as much as experience.

jobs.title: Staff Product Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200M+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer who thinks like a product owner and builds like a senior engineer. This is a role for someone who has shipped product that millions of people use, owned features from the first sketch to the metrics review, and knows when to move fast and when to build for the long run. You'll work across the stack, shape what we build as much as how we build it, and set the bar for product engineering at Fanvue. AI is transforming how we build software and what our product can do, and you'll be at the centre of both.

💰 £150,000

📍 Salary based on London. Other locations may vary.

🎯 The Role

You'll own product areas end to end, working directly with product, design and data to decide what to build, then shipping it to creators and fans at speed. Our stack is TypeScript, React, Node.js and PostgreSQL on AWS. You'll lead the technical direction for major product bets, build AI-powered features that change how creators run their business, and make sure the platform underneath them scales as we grow. Beyond shipping, you'll be a bar raiser and mentor, and your presence will make every engineer around you more product-minded.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Own major product areas end to end, from discovery and scoping through to launch, iteration and measuring impact

  • Partner with product managers and designers to shape the roadmap, challenge assumptions and find the simplest path to value

  • Build full-stack features in TypeScript, React and Node.js, designing the APIs and data models behind them

  • Ship AI-powered product experiences for creators and fans, including automated chat, content tools, moderation and recommendations

  • Run experiments, read the data and use what you learn to decide what to build next

  • Make pragmatic architecture calls that let us ship fast today without boxing us in tomorrow

  • Build reusable product primitives and patterns that help other teams ship faster

  • Use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate delivery and help define team standards

  • Mentor engineers across the organisation through code reviews, design sessions and pairing, with a focus on product thinking

  • Talk to creators, review support feedback and stay close to the people using what you build

  • Participate in incident response and own the quality and reliability of your product areas

👀 Who You Are

  • 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a strong track record of shipping user-facing product

  • Proven impact on products used by millions, with clear examples of features you owned and the results they drove

  • Deep expertise in TypeScript, React and Node.js, with solid experience across APIs, PostgreSQL and AWS

  • Strong product sense: you know what good looks like for users and can argue for it

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, turning a loose problem into a shipped solution without waiting for a perfect spec

  • Experience building with LLM APIs and AI-powered features in production

  • Fluent with AI-assisted development tools and keen to help teams adopt them effectively

  • A natural mentor who elevates other engineers through example, not authority

  • Strong communicator who can work as easily with designers and commercial teams as with engineers

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You care about the outcome for users, not just the quality of the code

  • You want to see your work in front of creators and fans within days, not quarters

  • You enjoy owning a problem end to end and being accountable for the result

  • You are motivated by mentoring and raising the product bar for teams

  • You are excited about building AI-native product experiences

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You prefer management or strategy over hands-on engineering

  • You want detailed specs handed to you rather than helping shape them

  • You are not comfortable owning the quality and reliability of what you ship

  • You see mentoring as outside your job description

  • You are resistant to AI tools changing how engineering works

🌍 Why Join Fanvue

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Fanvue supports hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans globally. The product you build here is in their hands immediately

  • AI-native engineering: we are not bolting AI on. It is core to our product and how we build

  • A company that values deep technical and product excellence, not just management progression

  • Series A momentum: triple-digit growth means the product you ship today defines the platform for years

  • Work alongside engineers who have shipped at scale across leading tech companies

  • Significant equity so you share in what we're building together

  • Fully remote with unlimited PTO, flexible working hours, a London office and WeWork access when you want it

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

  • Travel and office budgets for team off-sites or kitting out your home setup

  • Benefits package including gym memberships, apps, and more we're actively building out

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We believe the best teams are built on diversity of thought, background, and experience. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or age. What matters to us is potential, mindset, and what you will build.

  • Experienced leading cross-functional growth teams spanning PM, Engineering, Data, and Growth Marketing.

  • Comfortable owning a marketing P&L and hiring senior ICs to a high bar.

  • Ideally: experience in two-sided marketplaces, creator platforms, PLG SaaS, or consumer subscription businesses.

  • You operate well in ambiguity and build the org chart yourself rather than needing one handed to you

  • Comfortable across frontend and backend, and willing to go wherever the problem is

jobs.title: Fraud Investigator (Crypto)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
💰 £25k-£60k, depending on experience and location

📍 UK / Europe / Remote

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

As crypto usage on Fanvue's payment rails keeps growing, so does our exposure to crypto-specific fraud and financial crime. Recent cases have shown gaps in the Fraud team's crypto knowledge, and right now nobody on the team has dedicated crypto fraud or financial crime expertise. This role exists to build that capability from the ground up.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring Fanvue's first Fraud Investigator with dedicated crypto expertise, reporting to Head of Fraud. AI has taken our fraud detection as far as it can on crypto rails, what's missing is in-house subject matter expertise: someone who has used these investigation tools before, can set the strategy, and can train the rest of the team.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Lead on investigating cases of potential fraud or financial crime where crypto rails are involved, including payment fraud, account takeover, and money laundering typologies on crypto on/off-ramps

  • Build out crypto-specific fraud investigation capability within the Fraud team: on-chain tracing methods, tooling, and documented process for crypto-related cases

  • Train the wider Fraud team on crypto fraud red flags and typologies, so risk indicators get caught earlier in standard triage, not just by you

  • Design how Fanvue prevents and detects crypto-related fraud and financial crime as the function matures

  • Work directly with vendors to get the most out of crypto investigation tooling and data

  • Support fraud and financial crime investigations where crypto isn't involved, as part of the wider Fraud team's caseload

  • Lead on escalations to law enforcement where relevant

  • Feed your expertise into loss prevention strategy across Fraud, product, and payments

👀 Who You Are

  • 3+ years investigating fraud and/or financial crime with specific crypto/blockchain exposure, from an exchange, blockchain analytics firm, bank crypto desk, or law enforcement crypto unit

  • A process creator and improver: you've played a role in designing or improving investigation techniques, not just following them

  • Comfortable being the subject matter expert. As our first crypto-focused Fraud hire, you'll build the wider team's knowledge while acting as the go-to for other parts of the business (payments, payouts, product) wherever crypto risk shows up

  • Familiar with crypto investigation tooling (e.g. Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic, etc.) and know how to get the most from it in a fraud prevention context

  • High ownership: excited by a large, expanding remit, and not afraid to break new ground without an existing playbook

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You want to build a function from scratch rather than inherit one

  • You're energised by being the go-to expert and enjoy teaching others what you know

  • You like combining hands-on casework with process and systems design

  • You're comfortable working across functions, Fraud, product, payments, to get crypto risk taken seriously

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You need an established playbook, team, or tooling already in place before you can be effective

  • You'd rather stay purely hands-on and not upskill others

  • You're not comfortable being the sole specialist accountable for a new risk area

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • A genuine greenfield opportunity: build Fanvue's first in-house crypto fraud capability from scratch

  • Direct exposure across Fraud, Payments, and Product as crypto usage grows

  • AI-native: we are not bolting AI on, it's core to our product and how we work

  • Remote-friendly across UK/Europe

  • High annual leave flexibility

  • Support with upskilling and development costs

  • Benefits package including gym memberships, apps, and more we're actively building out

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

jobs.title: Moderation and Compliance Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
📍 Remote / London

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We’re an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Content volume is rising fast, and automated detection handles a growing share of low-risk cases. The work that matters most is still human-led: high-risk decisions where context and judgement matter. This role helps keep creators and fans safe, improves policy and tooling through real-world feedback, and keeps us audit-ready as we scale.

🎯 The Role

We’re hiring a Moderation & Compliance Executive to protect platform integrity by reviewing content, investigating violations, and making fast, fair decisions at scale. You’ll report to our Moderation Manager as part of the Trust & Safety team.

This is an overnight role: 2am to 9am UK time, Tuesday to Saturday. We’re fully remote. If those hours fall in your normal working day where you’re based, even better.

🚀 What You’ll Do

  • Review and action user-generated content against Fanvue’s content and community guidelines

  • Investigate Terms of Service violations (explicit content policy breaches, impersonation, copyright claims/DMCA, off-platform risks)

  • Work moderation queues in our tooling, prioritising by risk and turnaround time

  • Escalate high-risk and edge cases to the Moderation Manager and Head of Trust & Safety, with clear decision notes

  • Spot patterns and emerging risks, and feed insights back into policy and tooling improvements

  • Keep clean records of decisions to support audits, compliance reviews, and appeals

  • Partner with Support and Creator teams on escalations involving account restrictions or compliance concerns

  • Cover the overnight shift reliably and handle sensitive content with consistency, empathy, and fairness

👀 Who You Are

  • 2+ years in Trust & Safety, content moderation, or compliance (ideally in UGC, social, or platform environments)

  • Strong judgement and fast decision-making on grey-area cases

  • Clear written communication, high discretion, and calm handling of sensitive content

  • Comfortable using tools like Slack, Notion, Intercom, Retool (or similar)

  • Valuable: moderation frameworks, DMCA workflows, Online Safety Act, EU Digital Services Act, platform TOS enforcement

  • Comfortable reviewing adult-only (18+) content

✨ You’ll Thrive Here If

  • You like high-signal operations work and making principled decisions quickly

  • You care about fairness, consistency, and auditability, not just queue volume

  • You can handle edge cases without freezing, and escalate cleanly when needed

  • You enjoy improving systems (templates, tags, decision notes) as well as executing

⚠️ You’ll Struggle Here If

  • You need rigid rules for every decision

  • You are uncomfortable with adult content

  • You can’t commit to regular overnight hours

  • You avoid accountability for decisions and documentation quality

  • You need close supervision to stay on track

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don’t just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Real input into policy, tooling, and how Trust & Safety operates day-to-day, with strong engineering support and a tight loop from operations to product

  • AI-native: we are not bolting AI on, it’s core to our product and how we work

  • Fully remote

  • High annual leave flexibility

  • Support with upskilling and development costs

  • Benefits package including gym memberships, apps, and more we’re actively building out

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

jobs.title: Accounts Assistant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
💰 £40,000–£45,000

📍 Salary based on London. Other locations may vary.

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Behind the product is a finance function that needs to be as fast and reliable as the platform itself.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring an Assistant Accountant to own the accounting engine of the finance team: the ledger, the month-end close, and the admin that keeps both clean. Our day-to-day transaction processing is supported by an outsourced bookkeeping partner. You'll own the quality of that work, the reconciliations behind it, and everything between a receipt landing and a number reaching the board pack.

Everything else in finance, reporting, forecasting and investor diligence depends on the ledger being right. You'll make sure it is: reviewing what goes in, reconciling what comes out, and closing the month on time. About a quarter of the role is finance admin. It means running the invoice inbox, chasing receipts and keeping supplier records clean, and it's what keeps the numbers right.

🚀 What You'll Do

Ledger and close

  • Review and own the ledger in Xero, including our outsourced bookkeepers' work on coding, supplier bills and daily bank reconciliations across GBP, USD and EUR accounts

  • Prepare month-end journals, accruals and prepayments, and the balance sheet reconciliations behind them, so we close by working day 5 with our Finance Manager

  • Keep intercompany balances with our US entity reconciled

  • Reconcile payroll, PAYE and pension control accounts to Rippling each month

  • Prepare the UK VAT return in Xero for review

  • Prepare year-end schedules and answer queries from our external accountants and auditors

Finance admin and communication

  • Run the invoice inbox, logging, chasing and routing supplier invoices so nothing reaches the ledger without a document

  • Chase receipts and missing context from colleagues for card spend, and keep receipt compliance high

  • Maintain supplier records and support onboarding, including verifying bank details before anything is paid

  • Be the first point of contact for finance questions from the wider team

👀 Who You Are

  • 2 to 4 years in a finance team or accounting practice, with at least one month-end close owned end to end

  • AAT qualified, or studying towards or part-qualified in ACCA, CIMA or ACA. We'll support your studies

  • Confident in Xero or similar cloud accounting software, and comfortable with large data sets in Excel or Google Sheets

  • Experience with multi-currency reconciliations and high transaction volumes

  • Clear, friendly written communication. You'll chase people across the company and keep it pleasant

  • Fintech, marketplace or payments experience is a strong plus

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • A fully reconciled balance sheet gives you real satisfaction

  • You chase people for answers instead of waiting

  • You see the admin as part of getting the numbers right, not a distraction from it

  • You're comfortable in a startup where things move fast around you, even if your work is methodical

  • You want to grow into a management accountant or financial controller role as the team scales

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You want to work only on the numbers and see chasing colleagues for receipts as beneath the role

  • You need heavy supervision or detailed instructions for every task

  • You're not comfortable working with high transaction volumes daily

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Your work has immediate, visible impact. When the books are clean, the whole company moves faster, leadership gets reliable numbers, and investor conversations go smoothly

  • A clear path to grow, with study support and room to step up as the finance team expands

  • Fanvue supports hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans globally. The problems you solve here are real and immediate

  • Fully remote with unlimited PTO, flexible working hours, a London office and WeWork access when you want it

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

  • Travel and office budgets for team off-sites or kitting out your home setup

  • A benefits package we're actively building out, including gym memberships and apps

  • A culture built on innovation, speed, excellence, ownership and transparency

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

📍 Salary based on London. Hybrid, with flexible hours.

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Close, audit, tax and payments operations are already covered by the finance team. What has not been built yet is planning. This role exists to make planning a discipline the leadership team uses every week: a forecast budget owners trust, and unit economics that change decisions.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Senior FP&A Analyst/Senior Commercial Analyst to build and own Fanvue's company model, forecasting and commercial analysis, reporting to our VP Finance.

This is hands-on. You will build the driver-based model the executive team and board run the business on, turn creator, fan and payments data into unit economics people act on, and partner directly with budget owners across the business. It suits someone who has built models from scratch, pulls their own data, and can put a number on every outcome they claim.

This is not a reporting role. Someone strong on reporting but weak on building models is the wrong hire here, however polished.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Build and own the company model: a driver-based forecast with base, upside and downside cases that leadership and the board use

  • Forecast GMV and net revenue from the real drivers: creators, paying fans, spend per fan, cohorts, seasonality and take rate

  • Run the budget and monthly reforecast, and explain variances in terms budget owners can act on

  • Analyse unit economics, cohorts, pricing and margin, and use that analysis to change pricing and deal decisions

  • Partner with department heads on spend, bringing data and options rather than simply saying no

  • Pull your own data with SQL, reconcile it back to the ledger, and automate reporting so it runs without you

  • Bring AI tools into the planning and reporting workflow

  • Own monthly investor reporting and contribute to board packs and fundraising data rooms

👀 Who You Are

  • You have built a driver-based forecast or company model from scratch, and can walk through every driver in it

  • You have done analysis that changed a pricing, deal or spending decision, and you know the numbers before and after

  • You write SQL and are comfortable in a BI tool. You do not wait for someone else to hand you the data

  • You have run budget reviews with department heads and are trusted by them

  • Experience in a two-sided marketplace, payments, subscription or e-commerce business

  • A scale-up background, ideally having built something from scratch in ambiguity and chosen that stage

  • Experience in the creator economy or a high-risk payments category

  • Exposure to a fundraise or a data room

  • Reporting pipelines automated end to end

  • Background in STEM

  • You like being in the room when the decision is made, not reporting on it afterwards
